title: Choosing the Twelve

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bartholomew may be the same man John's Gospel calls Nathanael. Thaddaeus is also called Judas son of James.

puzzle.prompt: Jesus chose His apostles. Tap each one to count them.
puzzle.question: How many apostles did Jesus choose?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now all twelve were with Jesus: fishermen, a tax collector, a zealot, and others the Bible tells us little about.

bsb: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

puzzle.prompt: Match each apostle to something about him.
puzzle.hint: Look at each Disciple Card in the ☰ menu if you need help.

bsb: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

reflect: Before choosing the Twelve, Jesus prayed all night. Then He chose them first of all to be with Him.
discuss: Why do you think Jesus prayed all night before choosing the Twelve?
The Twelve were very different people. What does that tell us about who Jesus calls?
Mark says Jesus chose them “to accompany Him.” How can we spend time with Jesus?
prayer: Lord Jesus, You chose ordinary people to be with You. Help us spend time with You and follow You too. Amen.
